svg.title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Chasing Closings
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Chasing Closings; subtitle: Four buckets across $20,000, $60,000, and $100,000 launch budgets.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are middle-budget USD components and sum to $60,000. Each stage's value and detail also specify lean and upper-budget components; those columns sum to $20,000 and $100,000. These are capital plans, not revenue scenarios. Launch spending and reserve balances must not be counted twice.; caption: The middle plan allocates $12,000 + $8,000 + $10,000 + $30,000 = $60,000. A reserve cannot erase the 3–9 month first-deal interval or fund unlimited failed-closing work.; stages: label: Licensing and professional setup; value: Lean $4,000 | Middle $12,000 | Upper $20,000; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Fund jurisdiction-specific licensing analysis, filings where required, engagement drafting, insurance setup, and compensation review. Restrict launch geography when available capital cannot support the required scope.; label: Secure operating infrastructure; value: Lean $3,000 | Middle $8,000 | Upper $12,000; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Configure HubSpot, Airtable, Microsoft 365, secure document access, MFA, and backup procedures. Distinguish implementation spending and prepaid subscriptions from later monthly operating expenses.; label: Lender and referral development; value: Lean $3,000 | Middle $10,000 | Upper $18,000; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Build lender coverage, attend targeted industry events, and develop borrower education materials. Validate permitted referral arrangements before paying anyone for financing introductions or transaction outcomes.; label: Uncommitted operating reserve; value: Lean $10,000 | Middle $30,000 | Upper $50,000; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Preserve cash for collection delays and failed files. The middle reserve covers 7.5 months at $4,000 monthly cash burn but only 1.67 months at $18,000; nine months at $18,000 requires $162,000 before setup costs.

rect.title: label: Licensing and professional setup; numeric value: 12000.0; value: Lean $4,000 | Middle $12,000 | Upper $20,000; detail: Fund jurisdiction-specific licensing analysis, filings where required, engagement drafting, insurance setup, and compensation review. Restrict launch geography when available capital cannot support the required scope.

Distinguish implementation spending and prepaid subscriptions from later monthly operating expenses.

Validate permitted referral arrangements before paying anyone for financing introductions or transaction outcomes.

The middle reserve covers 7.5 months at $4,000 monthly cash burn but only 1.67 months at $18,000; nine months at $18,000 requires $162,000 before setup costs.
